backend.envVarValue: bare host only, e.g. http://172.16.0.12 (no path)
backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object|array|null }
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> (see CLAUDE.md API rule 3) — injected globally by src/proxy.js + src/app/api/_lib/proxy.js, never per-route

plantField.name: plant_code_id
plantField.note: This domain uses plant_code_id, not the generic plant_code. Sent per CLAUDE.md Rule 0: body for JSON POST/PUT, query params for GET/DELETE AND for multipart POST. NEVER as a custom X-PlantCodeId header — an earlier version of riskTemplateService.js/unitLevelService.js/route.js sent this header on every call; it was removed app-wide (see CLAUDE.md Rule 0 history) because no backend ever consumed it.

notes: Single catch-all proxy route (src/app/api/risk-template/[...path]/route.js) covers the entire domain — both riskAssessment/equipmentDropdown/failureModes/tags/uploadExcel AND the newer unitLevel sub-resource. No per-endpoint route files exist for this domain (unlike symbolic-ai).
The gateway prefix '/api/decisionops-pod2/p1/riskTemplate' lives entirely in backends.js BACKEND_PATHS.RISK_TEMPLATE — the route file itself sets no prefix, segments map straight through.

Two backend sub-resources share this one proxy: Risk Assessment (equipmentDropdown, failureModes, tags, riskAssessment CRUD, uploadExcel) and Unit Level (unitLevel + unitNumbers/unitDescriptions), split across two service files that both point at the same BASE.

endpoints.name: getUnitNumbers
endpoints.description: Distinct unit numbers for the Unit Level cascading dropdown.
endpoints.notes: Flat string array, index-aligned with getUnitDescriptions (same length/order in the doc sample: 19 items each).

endpoints.name: getUnitDescriptions
endpoints.description: Distinct unit descriptions, index-aligned with getUnitNumbers.
endpoints.notes: Frontend (useUnitLevel.js) zips this array with getUnitNumbers by index into { unit_number, description } option pairs — same cascading-select pattern as equipment -> failure mode.

endpoints.name: createUnitLevel
endpoints.description: Create a Unit Level master-data record.
endpoints.notes: Doc row gave a relative path ('/unitLevel') instead of the full URL like every other row — same endpoint, just an inconsistency in how the table was compiled, not a different host/prefix.

endpoints.name: getUnitLevelRecords
endpoints.notes: priority comes back as a STRING even though sent as a number in create/update — useUnitLevel.js's recordToRow() normalizes it via the same score() string-coercion helper used for severity/occurrence/detectability in useRiskTemplate.js.

endpoints.name: deleteUnitLevel
endpoints.description: Delete a Unit Level record by id.

endpoints.name: updateUnitLevel
endpoints.description: Update a Unit Level record's mutable fields only.
endpoints.notes: unit_number/description are NOT accepted on update (create-only fields) — mirrors the same 'update covers mutable fields only' convention as riskAssessment.

endpoints.status: OPEN ISSUE — see openIssues below. Live UI shows zero options despite this exact documented shape matching the frontend normalizer (normalizeEquipment in useRiskTemplate.js).

endpoints.name: getFailureModes

endpoints.name: getTags
endpoints.description: Fixed PLC tag names available for a given equipment, keyed by equipment_id. Backs the 'Detection Parameters' multi-select (TagMultiSelectField in RiskFields.jsx).

tags: ... 40 total, see original doc sample for the full list ...

endpoints.name: getAllRiskAssessment
endpoints.notes: Full doc sample has 15 records across multiple equipment (Clinker Cooler, Cement Mill #1, Coal Mill) — shape shown here is representative, not exhaustive; see chat history for the full sample set if needed.

endpoints.notes: Exported by riskTemplateService but NOT currently called by any consumer (useRiskTemplate.js only uses getAllRecords) — kept because it's a valid, documented endpoint, not dead code to delete.

plantCodeId.note: Doc sample for this endpoint doesn't mention plant_code_id at all ('Multipart form-data: file=test_upload.xlsx' only) — sent anyway per Rule 0. Placed in query params (not formData.append) per the symbolic-ai precedent that multipart scalar fields belong in query params, not form fields — fixed from an earlier formData.append('plant_code_id', ...) implementation that predated that rule being confirmed. Not yet independently verified live on this specific endpoint.

openIssues.issue: Live UI shows zero options in Equipment Name / Failure Mode / Detection Parameters dropdowns on /admin/risk-template.
investigated: Confirmed via curl that the proxy resolves to the correct upstream URL (x-target-url header matched the documented path exactly) for equipmentDropdown, unitLevel/unitNumbers, and tags.

Confirmed no plant selector exists on the risk-template page itself — plantId is read-only from AppContext, set exclusively via /admin/domain-configuration/data-source-integration's PlantIdSelector and persisted to localStorage as admin_plant_id. If unset, useRiskTemplate.js's load() bails before firing any request (if (!plantCode) return).

Added explicit warning-banner error surfacing (useRiskTemplate.js/useUnitLevel.js 'warning' state) so a failed getEquipmentDropdown/getFailureModes/getTags/getUnitNumbers/getUnitDescriptions call now shows its real error message in the UI instead of silently resolving to an empty array via .catch(() => []).
openIssues.notUsed: Ruled out: the X-PlantCodeId header was suspected but is confirmed correct as removed — CLAUDE.md Rule 0 documents this was an app-wide, intentional removal (no backend ever consumed it), not specific to risk-template.
openIssues.nextStep: Reload the page with a plant selected and read whichever warning banner (if any) appears — its message (e.g. an auth failure, a 404, or a genuinely empty response) will pinpoint the real cause. Not yet confirmed as of this update.
